name: Cynthia Romo
office: City of Cudahy, Member of the City Council

items.text: Cynthia Romo is a marketing and outreach regional director for AltaMed Health Services. She holds a master's degree in public administration from CSU Long Beach. She supports economic development that creates jobs and a balanced approach to the city's finances that protects essential services while strengthening its fiscal foundation. In a candidate questionnaire, she identified the biggest need facing Cudahy as ensuring the long-term well-being and stability of working families, and called for greater transparency to make city government easier for residents to understand and access.
